About the role

As renewable energy reshapes the global power system, batteries are taking center stage. Making them safe, reliable, and bankable at scale is a defining challenge of the energy transition. At TWAICE, our software turns battery data into insights - so decisions are made with confidence, not guesswork.

We're accelerating the transition into a new energy era and we're looking for those who want to move fast with us.

As a Full-Stack Software Engineer, you will be working in our product teams to create customer value at a high pace. This includes taking part in the full product development cycle, from understanding user problems and shaping solutions to building and iterating on them. You will work in a team with backgrounds in Software and Battery Engineering – creating solutions to get our projects from definition to customer value quickly while making sure we deliver robust, scalable, and extensible software products.
Together, we will push our battery analytics to the next level.


Your daily business will involve

  • Contribute to and help shape the feature set of our SaaS product in incremental and result-oriented steps
  • Implement new software components across the stack, from our backend services to our API layer and frontend serving customers across industries
  • Take ownership of features and parts of the product – from refinement through implementation to maintenance – with guidance from the senior engineers in your team
  • Continuously ship code to production through our CI/CD process and apply monitoring and observability best practices to make sure everything runs smoothly
  • Grow your craft with us: pair with experienced engineers, contribute to code reviews and take part in regular cross-team knowledge sharing


Your profile

Features verantwortest du end-to-end: von der Idee über die Gestaltung bis zum Release, bei Bedarf auch ohne Designer an deiner Seite.
